item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct evidence that Tshisekedi issued a public, specific doctrine on civilian protection, prisoner treatment, necessity, or proportionality. I also found no transparent accountability record showing he took responsibility for foreseeable atrocities by proxies or clearly punished them for abuses in a way that changed behavior. The public record is therefore indirect: peace-process messaging and some control efforts on one side, proxy reliance and rights-abusive discipline on the other.","evidence":[{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation : une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government described P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and cohesion program meant to restore state authority where absent.
